subject.title: fix(doctor): repair ALTER-appended operator approval schema instead of wedging startup

question: Should doctor automatically rebuild these four shipped legacy operator-approval schemas while dropping rows whose resolution_ref cannot satisfy the current canonical constraint?
rationale: The code can establish the exact migration mechanics, but only a maintainer can accept the product-level retention policy for persisted approval rows during an upgrade repair.

options.title: Approve bounded repair
options.body: Accept deletion of unrepresentable transient approval rows and merge the exact-shape repair after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Require row preservation
options.body: Hold the PR and require a quarantine or reconciliation design for invalid approval rows before rebuilding the table.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded repair
recommendation.body: Accept deletion of unrepresentable transient approval rows and merge the exact-shape repair after exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the production-backed migration and is best positioned to confirm the intended lifecycle of these persisted approval rows.
